question_text: Describe how a decision-tree classifier could use historical records labelled "disease detected" or "not detected" to predict a category for a new patient. Input features include measured symptoms and age group.
adaptation_rationale: Narrow broad mining to explicitly scoped decision-tree classification with labelled examples. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Train the tree on labelled examples to choose feature-based splits associated with the categories. Apply the new patient’s feature values through the learned branches to a leaf that predicts one of the two categories. The prediction needs validation and is not a certainty.

marking_points.criterion: Uses historical feature values with supplied category labels.
Learns decision-tree feature splits from these examples.
Applies new features through the tree to predict a discrete category.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct answers meeting the same scoped requirement; valid alternative algorithms accepted where they meet any explicit question constraints.
partial_credit_notes: Award each specified criterion independently up to the allocation. Credit correct method after an earlier slip when consistent; do not award the same point twice.
